title: Learning Polyhedral Conformal Sets for Robust Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.08506v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Robust optimization (RO) provides a principled framework for decision-making under uncertainty, but its performance critically depends on the choice of the uncertainty set. While large sets ensure reliability, they often lead to overly conservative decisions, whereas small sets risk excluding the true outcome. Recent data-driven approaches, particularly conformal prediction, offer finite-sample validity guarantees but remain largely task-agnostic, ignoring the downstream decision structure. In this paper, we propose a decision-aware conformal framework that learns uncertainty sets tailored to robust optimization objectives. Our approach parameterizes a flexible family of polyhedral sets via data-driven hyperplanes and learns their geometry by directly minimizing the induced robust loss, while preserving statistical validity through conformal calibration. translated_title: 用于鲁棒优化的多面体保形集学习
translated_abstract: 鲁棒优化（RO）为不确定性下的决策提供了一个有原则的框架，但其性能关键取决于不确定性集的选择。虽然较大的集合能确保可靠性，但往往导致过于保守的决策，而较小的集合则有排除真实结果的风险。近年来出现的数据驱动方法，特别是保形预测，提供了有限样本有效性保证，但在很大程度上与任务无关，忽略了下游决策结构。在本文中，我们提出了一个决策感知的保形框架，可以学习为鲁棒优化目标量身定制的不确定性集。我们的方法通过数据驱动的超平面参数化了一类灵活的多面体集合族，并通过直接最小化由此产生的鲁棒损失来学习其几何结构，同时通过保形校准保持统计有效性。为了校正数据依赖的选择偏差，我们引入了一个再校准步骤……
tldr: 该论文提出一个决策感知的保形框架，通过数据驱动方式学习适配鲁棒优化目标的多面体不确定性集，在保持有限样本统计有效性保证的同时降低决策的保守性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-aware conformal framework that learns polyhedral uncertainty sets tailored to robust optimization objectives, reducing decision conservativeness while preserving finite-sample statistical validity guarantees.
